title: Berri the Little Whale and the Dancing Northern Sky
description: A little blue whale and her baby harp seal friend Sable follow a gentle tide to watch the northern lights dance, then drift peacefully to sleep in their cozy bay.

Berri.role: Main character; a little blue whale
Berri.color: Smooth powder-blue upper body with a pale ivory-blue underside
Berri.bodyShape: Young small rounded toy-like blue whale with two short rounded pectoral flippers, broad horizontal tail flukes, and one small blowhole on top of her head; no clothing, accessories, hands, or feet
Berri.face: Large expressive dark-brown eyes and a tiny curved smile

Sable.role: Supporting character; a tiny baby harp seal who first appears on page 3
Sable.color: Rounded cream-white body with a soft charcoal-gray nose and a subtle pale-gray heart-shaped marking across the upper back
Sable.bodyShape: Tiny baby harp seal about one-third Berri's body length, with short front flippers and small rear flippers; no clothing, accessories, arms, hands, or feet
Sable.face: Wide dark-brown eyes, tiny whiskers, and a gentle expression

settingBible.Northern Ocean Bay and Cove: A sheltered Arctic ocean bay connected by a gentle tidal passage to a quiet viewing cove, with snowy mountains, smooth coastal rocks, one small snow-topped island, scattered rounded ice floes, and calm seawater under dancing northern lights
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded ocean animals, lavender twilight fading to velvet navy night, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Berri keeps powder-blue body, ivory-blue underside, and a top blowhole only.
The seal companion is named Sable and first appears on page 3.
Page 14 art still shows the cove, so narration stays soft about the tide carrying them gently.
Pages 14–15 become sleepier; both are asleep on page 15.
No rescue, danger, rough seas, lettering, logos, or extra named characters.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: Far in the northern ocean lived Berri, a little blue whale who loved watching the evening sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Little powder-blue whale Berri swims alone through a peaceful Arctic bay at lavender-blue dusk.

pages.text: One evening, Berri saw a soft green shimmer above the snowy hills and wondered what it was.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri alone lifts her head above the water toward a faint pale-green ribbon beyond snowy hills.

pages.text: Those are the northern lights, said her friend Sable. They dance when the sky grows dark.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny cream baby harp seal Sable first floats beside Berri as both look toward the faint green glow.

pages.text: I would love to see them dance, whispered Berri, but Sable said to follow the gentle tide.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri and Sable face a wide passage between snowy headlands with smooth ripples under an indigo sky.

pages.text: The tide carried them past a little island wearing a fluffy hat of snow.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri swims slowly beside Sable past a small rounded rocky island topped with thick snow.
pages.timeOfDay: cooling blue dusk by the island

pages.text: They passed sleepy ice floes that drifted like pillows across the sea.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri glides among rounded ice floes while Sable rests on a nearby floe on mirror-smooth water.
pages.timeOfDay: deepening indigo dusk among ice floes

pages.text: Berri made one tiny fountain with her blowhole, and the soft mist floated into the chilly air.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri releases a small delicate puff of white mist from her blowhole while Sable watches delightedly.

pages.text: Look how the water holds the stars, said Sable. Berri peeked down and saw a thousand tiny sparkles.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri and Sable gaze into calm dark-blue water reflecting many small stars.

pages.text: The tide slowed beside a quiet, moonlit cove, and Sable said it was a lovely place to watch.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri and Sable arrive in a sheltered cove framed by snowy cliffs under a crescent moon and faint aurora.

pages.text: First, a ribbon of green stretched across the sky. Then another curled gently beside it.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri and Sable float side by side watching two luminous green aurora curtains above the cove.

pages.text: Soon, soft pink and violet joined the green, sweeping slowly from one end of the sky to the other.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide cove view beneath flowing green, pink, and violet northern lights with Berri and Sable in the foreground.

pages.text: They're beautiful, whispered Berri, and Sable smiled that they did not need to hurry.
pages.illustrationScene: Close peaceful view of Berri and Sable floating together beneath gently rippling aurora curtains.

pages.text: They watched until the colors grew softer and the stars seemed brighter than ever together.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri and Sable rest close together in the still cove as the aurora fades to pale-green wisps.

pages.text: The tide carried them gently beneath the quiet stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri and Sable rest gently in the quiet cove under nearly faded aurora and peaceful starry sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Berri and Sable together. Art still shows the cove; keep narration soft about the tide carrying them gently.

pages.text: Back in their cozy bay, Berri closed her eyes and drifted to sleep as the northern sky danced in her dreams.
pages.illustrationScene: Berri sleeps near the calm surface of her home bay while Sable sleeps curled on a small safe ice floe nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Berri and Sable together. Final bay sleep; both asleep.
